title: Sheafification component of the derived section comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that R^p f_*F=0 for every quasi-coherent O_X-module F and p>0 [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For each i∈ℤ, on D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], the functor E↦a(V↦H^i(RΓ(f⁻¹V,E))) is naturally isomorphic as a functor to O_Y-module sheaves to E↦H^i(Rf_*E). Here the presheaf is the full section cohomology presheaf [def-pc-derived-section-presheaf], a is module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and derived direct image is [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Compute the derived functor of module direct image followed by the forgetful functor on the functorial K-injective resolution. Its derived unit is invertible at every resolved complex, and the resolution map becomes invertible under Q, giving a natural factorization. Use the existing derivedModuleDirectImageFactorization for direct image itself. Exact module sheafification commutes with homology (mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso), and the invertible sheafification adjunction counit identifies forget followed by sheafification with the identity. Compose these comparisons on complexes and cancel precomposition by the localization Q using fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft.preimageIso. Finally restrict to the quasi-coherent derived subcategory. No acyclicity hypothesis or affine section comparison is needed.

theorem qcoh_acyclic_derived_sections_comparison_sheafification {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hacyc : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)),
      F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ (p : ℤ), 0 < p →
        IsZero ((schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f p).obj F))
    (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedSectionPresheaf f i ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u}
            (𝟙 (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj) ≅
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeHigherDirectImage f i)
